description: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across six medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—when a language model is fine-tuned on each specialty's data. The x-axis displays the six specialties, with each specialty having a group of six bars representing the model's performance on terms from all six specialties. The y-axis shows the negative log probability, ranging from approximately -22 to -27, where lower values indicate higher probability. For each specialty, the bar corresponding to the same specialty (e.g., the brown bar for Cardio when fine-tuned on Cardio) is the shortest, indicating the highest probability for terms from that specialty. This pattern is consistent across all specialties, suggesting that the model performs best on terms from the specialty it was fine-tuned on. The bars for other specialties are progressively longer, indicating lower probabilities. The chart also includes a legend indicating that the model was fine-tuned on the respective specialty, with the color of the bar corresponding to the specialty of the term being evaluated. The overall trend shows that the model's performance is highest for terms from the specialty it was fine-tuned on, with performance decreasing for terms from other specialties.
